subtitle: Manage your account and MoneyFlow preferences.
emailPasswordHint: Enter your current password to change your email address.
financialBody: Manage your currency and financial planning preferences.
currencyLocked: Currency is locked because you already have financial records. This prevents existing amounts from being interpreted as a different currency.
notificationsBody: Choose which MoneyFlow notifications you want to receive.

toggles.budgetAlertsBody: Get notified when you approach or exceed a budget.
toggles.goalRemindersBody: Receive reminders about your financial goals.
toggles.monthlyInsightsBody: Receive monthly summaries and spending insights.
toggles.recurringBody: Get reminders about upcoming recurring transactions.

password.mustDiffer: New password must be different from your current password.
password.changedBody: Your password has been changed. Please sign in again using your new password.

pro.body: Go deeper into your finances with advanced analysis and insights.
pro.keepUntil: You'll keep MoneyFlow Pro until {{date}}. After that, your account will return to the Free plan.
pro.keepUntilEnd: You'll keep MoneyFlow Pro until the end of your current period. After that, your account will return to the Free plan.
pro.cancelled: Your subscription has been cancelled. You'll keep Pro until the end of your current period.
pro.reactivated: Your subscription has been reactivated. Your Pro access will continue.
pro.usingProBody: Your Pro access is active. You can use advanced reports and other Pro features available in your account.
pro.deeperInsightsBody: Understand spending patterns beyond the basic dashboard.
pro.endedOn: Your Pro access ended on {{date}}. Renew to restore advanced reports, insights, and other Pro features.
pro.unlockBody: MoneyFlow Pro gives you advanced financial analysis to help you understand your money more deeply.
pro.analyzeBody: Analyze spending, budgets, and financial performance.
pro.topSpendingBody: See exactly where your largest expenses are going.
pro.budgetPerformanceBody: Understand how your actual spending compares with your budgets.
pro.renewBody: Restore access to advanced reports, deeper insights, and all Pro features.
pro.upgradeBody: Explore advanced reports, deeper insights, and more powerful financial analysis.
